title: Alginate-coated cobalt ferrite nanocomposite for preconcentration of heavy metals using dispersive solid phase extraction
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,12265-12274
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA10098D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Maheen Khan, Jameel Ahmed Baig, Farah Naz Talpur, Saima Perveen, Hassan Imran Afridi, Khalil Akhtar, Nadeem Raza
A natural polymeric ferrite adsorbent enables efficient dispersive solid-phase extraction, providing a rapid, reusable, and environmentally friendly analytical approach for the sensitive preconcentration of trace heavy metals from aqueous samples.
